text:
Alex (AE): Heads up — Nimbus wants a 2-week demo using a dedicated "guest" pool. They want baseline capacity (4 A100-equivalent), autoscale up to 12 for spikes, and a temporary burst discount to keep the demo predictable. Need deal-desk + finance ok and engineering to stand up the pool.

Maria (Sales Ops): @Sam (Deal Desk) can you review? Also please add billing tag `nimbus-poc` and request prorated invoice. :eyes:

Priya (Solutions Eng): From infra we can carve a guest pool. To control cost I recommend mixed GPUs (A100 + A500) and KV prefix caching. Draft autoscale config below.

Priya (Solutions Eng): ```json
{
  "min_instances": 4,
  "max_instances": 12,
  "gpu_mix": ["A100", "A500"],
  "burst_rate_limit": "1200req/min",
  "billing_tag": "nimbus-poc"
}
```

Eli (SRE): We can create the pool but without a committed SKU it will run as dedicated-ephemeral and could incur overage. Can enforce an operational spend cap at $8,000/week. We'll add a rate-limiter so traffic never exceeds the burst cap. Need finance + deal-desk to sign off.

Jonah (Finance): $8k/week cap is acceptable for a demo if sales agrees to cover any overage invoiced after the period. 50% off burst price for 14 days — that's a one-off concession, requires Deal Desk and a short amendment. Need SKU mapping for mixed-GPU billing.

deal-desk-bot: submitted request to deals queue #4387. Attach pricing calc and expected volumes.

Alex (AE): Estimated traffic: continuous demo traffic, 30 rps peak synthetic, ~6M tokens/day. Rough list-rate estimate = ~$14k/week. With proposed burst discount (~50% on burst tokens) it falls to ~$9k/week.

Jonah (Finance): Numbers look reasonable. Legal needs to sign the amendment. @legal-bot can you fast-track a 14-day amendment that includes: temporary discount, no SLA, no refunds beyond 7 days?

legal-bot: Received. Drafting short amendment template now — will need customer signature before pool provisioning.

Priya (Solutions Eng): One more request — enable eval hooks and response logging for quality metrics, and enable KV cache for repeated prompts. We'll instrument to capture regressions so we can rollback model variants if needed.

Eli (SRE): Ops will tag all usage with `nimbus-poc` so billing ties back. I can create the pool on Monday once amendment is signed. Who formally approves the 50% burst discount?

Sam (Deal Desk): Sam (Deal Desk): I can provisionally approve 50% burst discount for 14 days provided sales either prepay 50% of estimated demo spend or provide a PO/CC on file and Finance (Jonah) signs off on net30 terms. Also require a one-off SKU code: NIM-PROV-001. This approval is contingent on signed amendment.

Alex (AE): Customer prefers net30 with PO. I'll push for PO + signature today. If they push back we'll consider CC on file.

Sam (Deal Desk): Fine. Add approvers: Sam + Jonah. No pool until amendment signed and PO/CC received.

Alex (AE): Got it. I'll chase signatures and update this thread. Thanks everyone :pray:

deploy-bot: temporary pool request #557 created; awaiting approved amendment and billing info.

(End of thread)
